questions.question: I _ a student.
questions.hint: Say the sentence aloud and choose what sounds right after “I.”

questions.question: She _ my teacher.
questions.hint: The subject is one female person.

questions.question: They _ good friends.
questions.hint: The subject means more than one person.

questions.question: Mina lives _ Nepal.
questions.hint: The blank tells where Mina lives now.

questions.question: Ravi is _ Pokhara.
questions.hint: The sentence tells Ravi’s place of origin.

questions.question: Which spelling is correct?
questions.hint: Start with “teach” and add the ending for a person.

questions.question: We say _ when leaving.
questions.hint: Think about what you say before going away.

questions.question: What does “introduce” mean?
questions.hint: Imagine meeting a new classmate for the first time.

questions.question: This is _ schoolbag.
questions.hint: The ownership word comes directly before a noun.

questions.question: Ram lost _ pencil.
questions.hint: Ram is one boy who owns the pencil.

questions.question: Sita loves _ new dress.
questions.hint: Sita is one girl who owns the dress.

questions.question: This book is _.
questions.hint: The ownership word stands alone after “is.”

questions.question: Those pencils are _.
questions.hint: The pencils belong to a group of people.

questions.question: _ is my sister.
questions.hint: Choose a subject word for one girl.

questions.question: Please give the ball to _.
questions.hint: The missing word comes after “to” and refers to a boy.

questions.question: What does “belongings” mean?
questions.hint: Think about the items you pack in your schoolbag.

questions.question: I _ brush my teeth daily.
questions.hint: “Daily” means the action happens every day.

questions.question: She _ walks to school.
questions.hint: The action happens on most days, but not necessarily every day.

questions.question: He _ eats meat.
questions.hint: The sentence should mean he does not eat meat at any time.

questions.question: _ do you live?
questions.hint: The expected answer would be the name of a place.

questions.question: _ is your birthday?
questions.hint: The expected answer would be a date or time.

questions.question: _ are you crying?
questions.hint: The speaker wants to know the reason.

questions.question: Quarter past seven is _.
questions.hint: Move 15 minutes forward from seven o’clock.

questions.question: Half past nine is _.
questions.hint: Move 30 minutes forward from nine o’clock.

questions.question: Yesterday, I _ tired.
questions.hint: The sentence is about the past and has the subject “I.”

questions.question: They _ at school yesterday.
questions.hint: The sentence is in the past and the subject is plural.

questions.question: She _ absent yesterday.
questions.hint: Use a negative past form for one person.

questions.question: We _ late yesterday.
questions.hint: Use a negative past form for a group.

questions.question: _ you help me, please?
questions.hint: Choose the word that makes the request sound polite.

questions.question: Please _ the window.
questions.hint: After “please,” use the simplest form of the action word.

questions.question: What does “request” mean?
questions.hint: Imagine politely asking someone for help.

questions.question: Which response is polite?
questions.hint: Choose the response you could respectfully say to a teacher.

questions.question: How _ books are there?
questions.hint: Books can be counted one by one.

questions.question: How _ water do you drink?
questions.hint: Water is normally measured rather than counted.

questions.question: I have _ apple.
questions.hint: Say “apple” aloud and listen to its first sound.

questions.question: She bought _ mango.
questions.hint: Say “mango” aloud and listen to its first sound.

questions.question: Which noun is countable?
questions.hint: Choose something you can count as one, two, or three.

questions.question: Which noun is uncountable?
questions.hint: Choose something normally measured by weight or amount.

questions.question: What is the plural of “child”?
questions.hint: This word has a special plural form instead of simply adding “s.”

questions.question: What is the plural of “box”?
questions.hint: Easy

metadata.Skill: Check which ending is normally added after the letter “x.”

questions.question: A pen costs Rs. 30. Two cost _.
questions.hint: Add the price of the pen two times.

questions.question: Rice costs Rs. 80. Pay Rs. 100. Change?
questions.hint: Take the cost away from the amount paid.

questions.question: A horse is _ than a goat.
questions.hint: Only two animals are being compared.

questions.question: A mouse is _ than a cat.
questions.hint: Think about the size of each animal and compare only two.

questions.question: A train is _ than a bicycle.
questions.hint: Think about which one normally moves more quickly.

questions.question: This flower is _ than that one.
questions.hint: Long describing words often need another word before them.

questions.question: Everest is the _ mountain.
questions.hint: Everest is being compared with every other mountain.

questions.question: A cheetah is the _ animal.
questions.hint: One animal is being compared with all animals.

questions.question: Good becomes _ in comparison.
questions.hint: Medium

metadata.Skill: “Good” changes into a special form when comparing two things.

questions.question: Good becomes _ in superlative.
questions.hint: Medium

metadata.Skill: Think of the special form used when one is above all others.

questions.question: What is the opposite of “bigger”?
questions.hint: Imagine changing from a large size to a little size.

questions.question: Which word compares two things?
questions.hint: Look for a describing word used when comparing two people.

questions.question: The book is _ the table.
questions.hint: Imagine where you normally place a book while studying.

questions.question: The shoes are _ the bed.
questions.hint: Picture the shoes hidden below the bed.

questions.question: The bank is _ the school.
questions.hint: Imagine the two buildings facing each other across a road.

questions.question: The shop is _ the bank.
questions.hint: Imagine the two buildings standing side by side.

questions.question: The tree is _ two houses.
questions.hint: Picture one tree with a house on each side.

questions.question: The cat is _ the curtain.
questions.hint: The curtain blocks the cat from view.

questions.question: Which word shows location?
questions.hint: Choose the word that tells where something is.

questions.question: What does “opposite” mean?
questions.hint: Imagine two shops on different sides of the same road.

questions.question: The Sun _ in the east.
questions.hint: The sentence states a fact that happens every day.

questions.question: Water _ at 100°C.
questions.hint: The subject is singular, and the sentence states a scientific fact.

questions.question: He _ football every day.
questions.hint: The subject is one boy, and the action happens regularly.

questions.question: They _ meat.
questions.hint: Choose the negative form used with a plural subject.

questions.question: She _ coffee.
questions.hint: Choose the negative form used with one female person.

questions.question: _ he play cricket?
questions.hint: The question is about the regular action of one boy.

questions.question: _ they live here?
questions.hint: The question is about the regular action of several people.

questions.question: Which is a natural material?
questions.hint: Choose a material that comes directly from a living thing.

questions.question: _ left at the corner.
questions.hint: A direction normally begins with the basic form of an action word.

questions.question: _ straight for ten metres.
questions.hint: Choose the basic action word used for movement.

questions.question: _ touch the hot pan.
questions.hint: The sentence warns someone not to do an action.

questions.question: _ your hands before eating.
questions.hint: Instructions begin with the basic form of an action word.

questions.question: Which direction is opposite east?
questions.hint: Picture a compass and look directly across from east.

questions.question: Which direction is opposite north?
questions.hint: Picture a compass and look directly across from north.

questions.question: The hospital is _ the bank.
questions.hint: Picture the hospital and bank standing side by side.

questions.question: What does “straight” mean?
questions.hint: Imagine walking forward without changing direction.

questions.question: Yesterday, I _ home early.
questions.hint: The action was completed before today.

questions.question: She _ an apple yesterday.
questions.hint: Choose the special past form of the action word.

questions.question: They _ football last week.
questions.hint: The action is finished, and this is a regular verb.

questions.question: We _ a tiger at the zoo.
questions.hint: Imagine the zoo visit happened yesterday.

questions.question: He _ a new bicycle.
questions.hint: Choose the special past form of “buy.”

questions.question: The past form of “come” is _.
questions.hint: This verb does not make its past form by adding “-ed.”

questions.question: The past form of “walk” is _.
questions.hint: This regular verb needs the usual past-tense ending.

questions.question: Which word shows past time?
questions.hint: Choose the word that refers to the day before today.

questions.question: I stayed home _ it rained.
questions.hint: The rain explains why the person stayed home.

questions.question: I was tired _ I continued.
questions.hint: The second idea is surprising after the first.

questions.question: Mina bought rice _ vegetables.
questions.hint: Two similar shopping items are being added together.

questions.question: He cried _ he was hurt.
questions.hint: Being hurt explains the first action.

questions.question: The cat entered _ ate fish.
questions.hint: The same animal performs two actions.

questions.question: She is poor _ honest.
questions.hint: The sentence connects two contrasting descriptions.

questions.question: What does “frightened” mean?
questions.hint: Imagine how you might feel after hearing a scary noise.

questions.question: Which word gives a reason?
questions.hint: Choose the word used before an explanation.

questions.question: The boy _ running.
questions.hint: The subject is one boy, and the action is happening now.

questions.question: The girls _ dancing.
questions.hint: The subject means more than one girl.

questions.question: I _ reading a book.
questions.hint: The action is happening now, and the subject is “I.”

questions.question: Look! The dog is _.
questions.hint: “Look!” tells you the action is happening now.

questions.question: These flowers are very _.
questions.hint: The missing word should describe how the flowers look.

questions.question: _ book here is mine.
questions.hint: Only one nearby object is being pointed out.

questions.question: _ houses there are old.
questions.hint: Several objects far from the speaker are being pointed out.

questions.question: What does “popular” mean?
questions.hint: Think about a singer whom many people enjoy.

questions.question: I like _ books.
questions.hint: The action word after “like” should name an activity.

questions.question: She loves _ pictures.
questions.hint: The action word after “loves” should name an activity.

questions.question: He hates _ early.
questions.hint: The action word after “hates” should end like an activity name.

questions.question: They enjoy _ football.
questions.hint: After “enjoy,” use a form that names the activity.

questions.question: Mina _ like swimming.
questions.hint: Mina is one person, and the sentence is in the present.

questions.question: Which activity is a hobby?
questions.hint: Choose something people practise for fun or creativity.

questions.question: What does “creative” mean?
questions.hint: Think about someone who invents new drawings or stories.

questions.question: Which spelling is correct?
questions.hint: Begin with “garden” and add the activity ending carefully.

questions.question: Birds _ fly.
questions.hint: The sentence describes something birds are able to do.

questions.question: Fish _ walk.
questions.hint: Think about whether fish have the body parts needed for walking.

questions.question: I _ ride a bicycle now.
questions.hint: The sentence describes an ability the speaker has now.

questions.question: As a baby, I _ walk.
questions.hint: Think about an ability a very young baby normally lacks.

questions.question: My grandfather _ run fast.
questions.hint: The sentence describes something he was able to do earlier.

questions.question: A goalkeeper _ catch balls.
questions.hint: Think about the main job of a goalkeeper.

questions.question: Which animal can climb trees?
questions.hint: Choose the animal that uses hands and feet to move on branches.

questions.question: What does “ability” mean?
questions.hint: Think about a skill someone is able to perform.

questions.question: _ is your best friend?
questions.hint: The expected answer would be a person’s name.

questions.question: _ are you late?
questions.hint: The speaker wants an explanation.

questions.question: _ do you go to school?
questions.hint: The expected answer might be “by bus” or “on foot.”

questions.question: _ does school begin?
questions.hint: The expected answer would be a time.

questions.question: Do you like apples?
questions.hint: Repeat the helping word used at the beginning of the question.

questions.question: Can Rita swim?
questions.hint: Keep the same ability word in the short answer.

questions.question: I think school is important.
questions.hint: Choose the response showing the same opinion.

questions.question: I do not share that opinion.
questions.hint: Choose the response showing a different opinion.

questions.question: We _ visit Pokhara tomorrow.
questions.hint: The visit has not happened yet.

questions.question: She _ travel next week.
questions.hint: “Next week” shows that the action is still ahead.

questions.question: They _ play football tomorrow.
questions.hint: Choose the helping word used for a future action.

questions.question: I _ going to study.
questions.hint: Choose the helping verb that matches “I.”

questions.question: He _ going to cook.
questions.hint: The subject is one boy making a plan.

questions.question: We _ going to dance.
questions.hint: The subject means more than one person.

questions.question: _ you visit us tomorrow?
questions.hint: The question asks about an action that has not happened yet.

questions.question: The negative of “will” is _.
questions.hint: Look for the shortened form made from “will not.”
